components.name: Solar Cell String Assembly (monocrystalline silicon)
components.reasoning: Core photovoltaic conversion element, universally present as the primary functional component in all monocrystalline modules. Procured as assembled strings from specialized solar cell manufacturers.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: Front protective layer, industry standard in virtually all modules for weather protection and light transmission. Sourced from specialized glass manufacturers as complete units.

components.name: Aluminum Frame Assembly
components.reasoning: Structural support and mounting interface, standard in most installations though frameless variants exist for building-integrated applications. Manufactured as complete extruded assemblies.

components.name: Junction Box with Bypass Diodes
components.reasoning: Electrical connection and bypass diode housing, essential for safe electrical integration and performance optimization. Procured as complete assembly from electrical component manufacturers.

components.name: Encapsulation Film (EVA/POE)
components.reasoning: Protective polymer layer securing cells between glass and backsheet, industry standard though alternative materials like POE are emerging. Sourced from specialized polymer film manufacturers.

components.name: Backsheet Film
components.reasoning: Rear protective layer providing electrical insulation and moisture barrier, common but glass-glass variants replace this component in some premium modules. Manufactured by specialized film companies.

components.name: Edge Sealant System
components.reasoning: Weatherproof sealing compound around module perimeter, critical for moisture protection and structural integrity. Procured from specialty chemical manufacturers as complete sealing systems.

components.name: Interconnect Ribbon System
components.reasoning: Copper ribbons connecting individual solar cells within strings, essential for electrical conductivity. Manufactured as specialized tabbing wire by electrical component suppliers.
